_comment: Spell NAMES (as they appear in mythicsim-forever-engine/data/spells.jsonl) that Forte_Shaman tracks. gen_spell_data.py resolves each to its highest-rank spell ID + current duration/cooldown data. Names with no match in a given build are reported by the generator, not silently dropped -- re-check them after a mythicsim-forever-engine pull. Forever notes: the shaman kit gained new core spells (Riptide and Lava Lash join the shock/cooldown families, Molten Blast, Healing Rain, Decoy Totem, Stoneclaw Totem, Earthbind Totem, Feral Spirit, Rage of the Farseer, Totemic Projection); the Far Sight scry line is split into Call of the Elements/Spirits/Ancestors (L20/30/40) and Call of Flame/Thunder (L60); melee 'stamps' are Windfury/Flametongue/Rockbiter Weapon + Frostbrand. Shocks and totems often carry the cooldown as a shared category cooldown (e.g. shock category, Mana Tide category 591) -- the generator emits CategoryCooldownMs as cooldownMs. T1 (2026-11-02, docs/class-port.md 6.1 + PLAN 11.1 Q1/Q6 rulings): the reference's CAST spells are added to [cooldowns] -- Stormstrike (17364, 8 s + 12 s window), Lava Burst (1326047, 10 s shock-family category), Ancestral Guidance (the shaman pair of the paladin row; the family-11 rows 409333/409337/409944 carry no window on this build, pinned in Forte_Cooldown/tests/test_tracked_set.lua) and the family-less Q6 Heroism row (23689, durationMs -1). Maelstrom Weapon is a proc/passive: see _deferred_H7 / H7 (docs/design-combat-procs.md). Wave I-2b (2026-11-03, upstream-data §5.1/§7.9 + Blizzard dev notes post 9): Lava Burst PRUNED from [cooldowns] (post 9: 'Lava Burst removed (passive Call of Thunder replaces)' -- the client capture of 2026-11-03 still ships the 11-rank ladder, this is the hotfix-watch row: the day the store drops the name, the pruned list is what keeps the data clean; upstream-data §5 row 4); [totems] += Windfury Totem (the air-slot totem cast row -- post 9 adds the swing animation for both, upstream-data §4.4: a Windfury bar that appears with no totem cast is the legitimate Windfury Weapon stamp, the new totem row is the cast's own row); Call of Thunder 16120 stays in [utility] as the Far Sight scry spell ONLY -- the post-9 shaman talent of that name is NOT mapped onto it (upstream-data §5.1 'remove the Call of Thunder mapping', 16120 is value-less scry data); _renames carries the two post-9 renames (Totemic Projection <-> Totemic Call 437009, Elemental Mastery <-> Lightning Mastery 16166/16579-82): the data keys stay the client-captured spellings, the aliases reach the same rows (Forte_Core/Core/Locale.lua RenameAliases is the runtime twin).
